checks.quote: - name: Prompt digests match the release manifest
checks.note: The only baseline comparison is a CI step checking prompt file hashes and harness version against release/manifest.json. It reads repo files, not running state. Nothing compares running images, MCP server lists, permissions, network policies or self-hosted weights. The repo has no drift tool, and the README names no outside platform that does this.

CI triggers only on PR and push, with no schedule. The only CronJob (k8s/deployment.yaml:115) is the reminders worker. No per-deployment drift job exists in the repo. Scheduling could live outside the repo, so this can't be confirmed.
A mismatch only fails the CI build. There is no alert, no quarantine or rollback response in config, and no time limit. Without a drift check in the repo, there is no result handling to evaluate.

violates: Compare running images, harness settings, prompts, MCP server lists, permissions, network policies, and self-hosted model weights against their approved baseline
note: The repo's only baseline comparison is a CI check of prompt digests and harness version, so running images, MCP lists, permissions, network policies and weights are never compared.
